stem.text: The initial rate of a reaction catalysed by an enzyme was measured at various substrate concentrations.
Which graph shows the effect of a low concentration of non-competitive inhibitor on the reaction?

stem.alt: Key: a dashed line labelled without inhibitor and a solid line labelled with inhibitor.

A.alt: Graph of initial rate of reaction against substrate concentration, with a dashed curve rising to a plateau and a solid S-shaped curve starting near zero.

B.alt: Graph of initial rate of reaction against substrate concentration, with a dashed curve rising to a plateau and a solid straight-looking curve below it.

C.alt: Graph of initial rate of reaction against substrate concentration, with a dashed curve rising to a plateau and a solid straight line starting at zero.

D.alt: Graph of initial rate of reaction against substrate concentration, with a dashed curve rising to a plateau and a solid curve reaching a lower plateau.
